title: Changing the laws of physics under a living creature
equivalence: FieldLenia (ex_bizarre.py) repeats alm.lenia.Lenia's step with mu, sigma as arrays or functions of the step; with uniform S001 parameters it equals Lenia bitwise over 200 steps (checked at render: True)
caveats: The rule changes during the run; the creature is never at equilibrium with it, so its shape at a given mu or sigma is not the shape a creature would settle to at that fixed rule.
One ramp rate each. In a prototype, the mu ramp kept a single Orbium until mu ~ 0.114, then gave a two-lobed body and a world-filling lattice; the sigma ramp kept it until sigma ~ 0.022, then filled.
Gradual parameter change as a way to morph Lenia creatures is Chan's own method (2019 sec. 2.3.2).

runs.initial_state: settled S001 Orbium (48^2 crop) pasted centred on zero 256^2
runs.rule_note: S001 rule with mu ramped linearly from 0.15 at step 0 to 0.11 at step 1500; the step uses the value at its own step index

runs.initial_state: settled S001 Orbium (48^2 crop) pasted centred on zero 256^2
runs.rule_note: S001 rule with sigma ramped linearly from 0.015 at step 0 to 0.035 at step 1500; the step uses the value at its own step index

render.colormap: matplotlib inferno, A in [0,1] mapped linearly, nearest-neighbour
